legend: Abnormal FISH pattern with the RUNX1 (21q22) (red) and ETV6 (12p13) (green) probes in a metaphase cell and interphase nuclei (inset) in B-lymphoblastic leukaemia/lymphoma with t(12;21)(p13.2;q22.1)/ETV6::RUNX1. The probe set utilizes the extra-signal (ES)-FISH strategy, producing the two red, one green, and one fusion signal pattern (2R1G1F) in abnormal cells. In the metaphase cell, the fusion signal indicative of an ETV6::RUNX1 translocation is shown on derivative chromosome 21 (top, yellow signal). In interphase nuclei, the normal cell (inset, left) shows two red and two green signals corresponding to normal copies of the RUNX1 and ETV6 genes, respectively, and the abnormal cell (inset, right) shows the 2R1G1F pattern, consistent with an ETV6::RUNX1 rearrangement.
